story.heading: Reliable Well and Water Services in Maryland

At Freeland Well and Water Services we are a family-owned and owner-operated business dedicated to providing reliable Well, Plumbing and Gasfitting services you can trust.  Led by Andre Boshoff, a Master plumber, we take pride in delivering quality workmanship and honest advice.

We understand how important  dependable water and plumbing systems are to your home, which is why we focus on finding the right solution for every customer.  We believe in explaining the work that needs to be done, answering your Questions and making sure you understand  your options before we begin. We are committed to providing professional services with a personal touch and get it right the first time.

At Freeland Well and Water Services you are more than just a Customer - you are part of our community.

values.heading: Four Things We Will Not Compromise On

items.title: We only fix the problem
items.text: If the cheap repair is the right repair, that is the one you get quoted. We would rather have you call us again in five years than never again in one.

items.title: Evidence before treatment
items.text: Water gets tested before anything gets sold. Staining, smell and taste each point somewhere different, and guessing costs you money.

items.title: Fair, stated prices
items.text: You know what the work costs before it starts. If something unexpected turns up mid-job, we stop and talk to you rather than adding it to the bill.

items.title: We turn up
items.text: Booked times are kept. And when a pump dies at eleven at night, the emergency line is answered by someone who can actually help.

who.heading: Homeowners with any Water related Issue
who.body:
Our customers are households who rely on their own well rather than a municipal supply. That comes with a particular set of headaches: no water at all, water that stains everything it touches, water that smells wrong, pressure that surges and drops, and pumps that fail at the worst possible moment.

We handle all of it, plus the general plumbing that inevitably sits alongside it. One number to call, whichever part of the system has let you down.

detail.heading: What each service actually involves
detail.text: If you are not sure which of these you need, call and describe what the water is doing. That is usually enough for us to point you in the right direction over the phone.

symptoms.heading: Describe the symptom, we will name the cause
symptoms.text: Most water problems announce themselves in a fairly specific way. Here is the usual translation.

items.title: Orange or brown staining
items.text: Almost always iron. Confirmed with a water test, then handled with the right filter rather than a general-purpose one.

items.title: Rotten egg smell
items.text: Sulphur, or bacteria in the well. The fix differs completely depending on which — so it gets tested first.

items.title: Pump running constantly
items.text: Usually a waterlogged pressure tank. Left alone it will take your pump with it, so it is worth looking at early.

items.title: Water runs out in summer
items.text: A yield test tells you whether the well is genuinely under-producing or something else is limiting the flow.

items.title: Green stains on fixtures
items.text: Acidic water attacking copper pipe. A neutraliser stops it before you are replacing plumbing.

items.title: No water at all
items.text: Pump, pressure switch, wiring or the well itself. This is an emergency call — ring us whatever the hour.
